name: [👑 UPD 0.5 👥] Anime Overload!
desc:
The world of Anime Overload awaits you!🌟 

Upon a scientific discovery to link this world to others, to summon in "Heroes," a glitch occurs... ⚠️The world as we know it changed in an instant. It's up to you and the Heroes you ally with along the way to defend this Universe's peace. Summon your Heroes -grab a cool ride while you're at it, build your team, prepare your defenses and beat these Villains. This story has just begun....

✨ Explore a world full of unique and powerful Heroes, with unique passives and powerful Ultimates
💎 Level up and build your Heroes to the strongest this world's ever seen 
⚡ Weather the storm that approaches, fight the enemies in your way across multiple game-modes 

Useful Keybinds:
🛹T - Toggle Mount  
🪩G - Toggle Emote Wheel (Hold to keep open)
❗H - Toggle Session Information (in Stages)
❗U - Toggle Hero Manager (in Stages)
